correctness.rationale: Read the full RESULT.md and verify.py at the assigned tree. Distinct duads are graph-distance 2 exactly if disjoint and 4 otherwise; distinct synthemes distance 2 iff they share a duad and 4 otherwise; every duad-syntheme pair has distance 1 or 3. Hence threshold3 graph has all 225 cross edges and the two internal factor graphs, giving an ACTUAL simplicial join, not a homology-only assertion. Independently enumerated all 15 duads and all 15 perfect matchings on six elements. Each factor has 15 vertices,45 edges,15 triangles, no 4-cliques, is connected, and every edge belongs to a unique triangle. Elementary collapse of one edge per triangle leaves 15v30e connected graph and hence wedge^16 S1; join-smash yields wedge^(16*16) S3. The supplied verifier additionally checks full 30-vertex threshold3 f-vector (30,315,1380,2475,1350,225) and GF2 Betti 256, but mod2 rank alone would be weaker than the structural homotopy proof. Integer-distance constancy justifies the entire interval 3<=r<4.

originality.rationale: Searches with Tutte--Coxeter, Tutte 8-cage, Cremona--Richmond, GQ(2,2), duad--syntheme, generalized quadrangle and 256-sphere Rips aliases found no independent published coverage. The closest primary McCabe 2026 generalized-polygon paper proves girth-stability of graph-power clique complexes only for g>=3j+1: at g=8 and j=3 it is inapplicable. The Platonic-solid Rips paper concerns different metric sets and points toward buildings only as future direction. The structural join factorization is not implied by either theorem, though unindexed classical graph-power calculations remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: Older graph-power clique-complex literature may contain the identical small generalized-quadrangle invariant under different terminology.
Finite factor enumeration was verified independently; the global homotopy conclusion depends on the exact join and free-edge-collapse argument, not just GF2 Betti numbers.
No claim for arbitrary generalized quadrangles or scale4, and no general VR persistence barcode.

value.rationale: The Tutte--Coxeter graph is the canonical smallest thick GQ(2,2) rank-two building incidence graph, and scale3 is the first beyond the available girth8 stability range. The natural exact invariant 256 independent three-spheres follows from explicit two-sided geometry, not a numerical log or an arbitrary parameter slice. The result is a complete natural finite-object homotopy classification useful in VR/genus and generalized-polygon comparisons; no general theorem is required.

final_claim: For Tutte--Coxeter 30-vertex duad--syntheme incidence graph T with shortest-path metric, VR_<=r(T) is homotopy equivalent to a wedge of 256 S3 for 3<=r<4, via the join of two 15-vertex factors each collapsing to wedge^16 S1.
limitations: Exact ordinary homotopy for interval 3<=r<4 only.
